answer: According to the Data For Good white paper (Document ID = 6), in the case of a Meta translation model studied by Wu et al. (2022), over a two-year period, 35% of the model's total environmental impact came from the training (learning) phase, while the remaining 65% corresponded to the inference phase (serving predictions). Thus, the share of the model's two-year footprint that came from serving predictions rather than learning is 65%.
